name: SDN Epoch State
description: TLE-to-numerical handoff (Evidence-Supported ASO Catalog, section 5): evaluates each $MPE element set with SGP4 at zero elapsed time, transforms the TEME state to GCRF at the same instant (IAU 2006/2000A via ERFA, velocity including the frame rotation rate), verifies the round trip, and emits one single-row $OEM per element set with its lineage and initial-condition uncertainty marked unknown. Pure compute; output bytes depend only on input bytes.

sequentialJustification.detail: Each element set is evaluated independently in one bounded pass; the module starts no workers. Hosts parallelize by invoking separate instances on separate batches.

acceptedTypeSets.description: ALIGNED size-prefixed $MPE stream: concatenated [u32le length][$MPE buffer] frames; zero-length prefixes are padding. MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY must be SGP4; EPOCH is Unix seconds (UTC).
ALIGNED size-prefixed $OEM stream, one single-row OEM (GCRF, UTC, km and km/s) per derived element set, in input order.

outputPorts.description: Derived epoch states. Absent when no element set could be derived.

acceptedTypeSets.description: JSON: record, derived and failed counts, epochs outside the leap-second table, maximum round-trip residuals, and the refused element sets by input index with the reason and SGP4 error code.

wildcardJustification.detail: Run accounting for the derivation. Diagnostic metadata, never persisted as an observation.

methods.description: Derives one GCRF epoch state per $MPE element set. Refused element sets (theory other than SGP4, non-finite or invalid elements, SGP4 errors, round trip outside tolerance) are listed in the report and produce no OEM.
